name: Nerja (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the arms of Nerja (a crowned anchor within a yellow cartouche).
history: Municipal flag of Nerja; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
